# AAA Trade House

> AAA Trade House is the export brand of AAA General Trading, a general
> trading and export company based in Lahore, Pakistan, registered in
> 2009 and a registered Chamber of Commerce member. Contracts, invoices
> and banking are in the AAA General Trading name.
>
> The company's current export line is Himalayan pink salt. It sources
> primarily direct from PMDC-leased mines with no trading layer, and
> crushes and grades in-house at its own plant near Kot Abbas Shaheed,
> Khanewal, at over 100 tonnes per month across coarse, fine, edible and
> chunk grades. Family salt-trade experience dates to 1994.
>
> Two locations: the office in Lahore and the crushing and grading plant
> in Khanewal. Both addresses are below.

Every page of the site is prerendered, so the HTML already carries the
full copy without JavaScript. This file is the short version: what the
business is, where it is, what it sells and on what terms, stated once
in plain prose so an answer engine does not have to infer it from
marketing pages.

## What the business is

A general trading and export company. Himalayan pink salt is the line it
exports today and the whole of this site; it is the current focus rather
than the limit of what the company is set up to trade. Enquiries about
other categories go to the same address below.

No claim is made here to an established export record in any category
other than salt.

## What we supply

- Edible grade Himalayan pink salt, with PMDC certification at product level
- Industrial grade salt
- Animal lick salt
- Wellness and decor salt (lamps, blocks, tiles)
- Bulk and raw sourcing
- Private label, on bulk packaging and on 500 g / 1 kg retail packs

Packaging: 25 kg and 50 kg PP export bags, 500 g and 1 kg retail packs,
or a custom size to specification. 50 kg is the largest bag we fill.

Grades: coarse, fine, edible and chunk. Granulation is confirmed in
writing against the buyer's specification before commitment.

## Trade terms

- Incoterms: FOB is the usual basis; CIF available on request; other
  terms quoted to requirement.
- Load ports: Karachi and Port Qasim, depending on the booking.
- HS code: salt, including table salt and pure sodium chloride, sits
  under heading 2501. The national subheading varies by destination.
- Minimum order: none fixed. Volume, grade and packaging are quoted to.
- Lead time: not published. It depends on grade, volume, packaging and
  destination port, and is confirmed in writing before commitment.

## Testing and certification

Batches are PCSIR tested and an independent laboratory report is
available on request. The edible grade carries PMDC certification —
product-level on that grade, not company-wide. The salt is halal
certified.

## Facts about the product

- Himalayan pink salt is mined rock salt, crushed and graded rather than
  refined. The colour comes from the rock itself, not an added colourant.
- It is supplied non-iodised, and no anti-caking agent is added.
- Chemically it remains predominantly sodium chloride and is used in the
  same quantities as any other salt.
- Salt does not expire. It cannot support microbial growth, so kept
  sealed and dry it keeps indefinitely. Codex CXS 1-1985 4.7.1(vii)
  lists non-iodised food grade salt among foods requiring no date of
  minimum durability, and EU Regulation 1169/2011 Annex X names cooking
  salt in the same terms.

We make no health claims for this product. No authorised health claim
under EU Regulation 1924/2006 is available for salt.

## Where we operate

- Office: Office No. 42, Valencia Tower, Block K1, Valencia Town,
  Lahore 54770, Pakistan
- Plant: Near Kot Abbas Shaheed, Khanewal 60000, Pakistan
- Domestic: we ship to Karachi and across Pakistan under our own
  registered salt brand, alongside export orders.
